item.title: Social Democrat-proposed 14-student classes would require over 4000 additional teachers
item.description: The Social Democrats’ proposal to limit classes to a maximum of 14 students for grades 0-3 requires over 4,000 additional teachers. Presented at Pilegårdsskolen in Kastrup, they plan for the change to take effect by 2028, calling it “Lilleskolen.” Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen emphasized it would allow for more focused learning with less noise. item.title: Three Copenhagen lakes are now safe to walk on
item.description: In Copenhagen, three lakes, Brønshøj Gadekær, Brønshøj Kirkemose, and Peblinge Sø, are now frozen enough for public access. According to Copenhagen Municipality’s Climate, Environment and Technical Administration, the ice has reached a thickness of 18 centimeters, deemed safe for public access, as announced Wednesday. item.title: ICED: How Severe Cold Transforms Daily Life in Denmark
item.description: January was unusually cold and February started even colder. It is rare in a country where you suddenly can walk on icy lakes, industries are being disrupted and the winter is altering the rhythm of daily life

item.title: Google owner delivers better than expected earnings
item.description: In the fourth quarter of 2025, Alphabet, Google’s parent company, reported revenues of $113.8 billion, marking an 18% increase over the previous year.
